SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date January 10, 1938.

Subject Shanghai Municipality Entertainers Relief Association -
dissolved

Made by Clerk Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.S.

The Shanghai Municipality Entertainers Relief Association,
hitherto situated at No.5 Boo Liu Faung (步留坊), Avenue
Edward VII, which was inaugurated on July 27, 1937, and had
for its object the relief of unemployed entertainers, has been
dissolved. The registration certificate issued by the Shang-
hai Municipal Police on November 2, 1937, to the Association
has been returned to the Police Headquarters for cancellation
and is attached herewith.

This Association owes the landlord of the premises a
total of five months rent amounting to $450.00 (@ $90.00
per mensem). The Association has 83 dozen of Chinese
Brandy which was previously contributed to aid the Association,
and the five committee members of the Association, Tsu Siao
Foong (朱筱峯), Kiang Siao Siao (江笑笑), Liu Tse Yung
(刘子雲), Tsang Yeh Er (張冶兒) and Toong Tien Ming (董天民),
who are responsible for the winding up of the affairs of the
organization, are arranging to dispose of the wine in order to
obtain money to refund the rent which is in arrear.

Liao Chungchien.
Clerk

D.C. (Special Branch)

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 11 JAN. 1938）

（批：Filed on D 8157 C.I.）
（批：File No... REGIST... 2503 ... 38）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.1，特务科
报告
日期：1938年1月10日。

事由：上海市游艺救济会——已解散

由书记员廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien）撰写，由 C. Crawford 副督察转呈。

上海市游艺救济会此前位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）步留坊5号，该会于1937年7月27日成立，旨在救济失业艺人，现已解散。上海公共租界工部局警务处于1937年11月2日向该会颁发的注册证书已交回警察总局予以注销，并附于此。

该会欠房东共计五个月租金，总额为450.00元（每月90.00元）。该会存有83打中国白兰地酒，此酒系此前为资助该会而捐赠。该会负责清算事务的五名委员，即朱筱峯（Tsu Siao Foong）、江笑笑（Kiang Siao Siao）、刘子雲（Liu Tse Yung）、張冶兒（Tsang Yeh Er）和董天民（Toong Tien Ming），正安排处置这批酒类以获取资金，用于偿还拖欠的租金。

廖仲坚
书记员

D.C.（特务科）

（印：上海公共租界警务处特务科 1938年1月11日）

（批：归档于 D 8157 C.I.）
（批：档案号... 注册... 2503 ... 38）
（批：Jie / D.B.R. / 1/10）
